description: page-break-inside: avoid keeps a bordered card and a small table whole: each moves to the second page rather than being divided by the page boundary. Port-authored: the reference engine implements no break properties, so this Expectation records this port's behaviour rather than the reference's.
visual_assertions: The filler fills most of page 1; neither the card nor the table starts on it.
All six card lines and the card's border are on page 2, unbroken.
All four table rows are on page 2, below the card, unbroken.
